Sharpline HVAC

Commercial HVAC Portfolio

Sharpline HVAC delivers mechanical systems across commercial, institutional, and industrial projects with a focus on chillers, VRF, boilers, refrigeration, and complex piping scopes. The division has consistently handled large installations where precision installation, coordination, and commissioning support are essential.

McMaster University

Chiller Installation
LocationHamilton, Ontario, CanadaSystem200-tonne chiller · R-134a refrigerant · R-513A transition capability

A high-capacity chiller installation project at McMaster University involving a 200-tonne cooling system designed to handle institutional capacity demands. The project required careful refrigerant management with existing R-134a infrastructure while maintaining future upgrade compatibility for R-513A. This type of work demonstrates the crew's ability to deliver large mechanical installations in live institutional environments with rigorous scheduling and precision commissioning requirements.

Mohawk College

VRF System Installation
LocationHamilton, Ontario, CanadaSystem75-tonne variable refrigerant flow (VRF) installation · multi-zone capacity

A significant VRF project involving a 75-tonne multi-zone system serving institutional spaces at Mohawk College. VRF systems require detailed refrigerant piping runs, precise charge calculations, and coordinated control integration, all of which were part of this institutional delivery. Sharpline's crew handled the system installation, refrigerant line sizing, and indoor unit tie-ins across the facility.

75-tonne VRFMulti-zone variable refrigerant flow capacity requiring precise piping and lineset routing.
